notice.title: What you share
notice.usage: {named, select, true {Requests that {instance} sends run on your account and count against the limits of your plan.} other {Requests that this hub sends run on your account and count against the limits of your plan.}}
notice.tokens: The hub stores the sign-in for your account encrypted and renews it itself. It never sees your password.
notice.terms: Using a subscription through a third-party hub may break the terms of the provider. The provider can limit or ban the account.
notice.withdraw: After connecting you get a private link to check the account and disconnect it. You can replace or deactivate that link at any time. Without it, you can still end the hub's access at the provider.
notice.accept: I understand and want to share my account

done.title: {count, plural, one {Account connected} other {# accounts connected}}
done.description: Thank you. The hub can now use these accounts.
done.manageHint: Save this link. It shows the status of your accounts and lets you disconnect them at any time. Anyone with this link can disconnect them, so keep it to yourself.
done.full: This link cannot add more accounts.
done.skipManage: I don't need a manage link
done.manageOffHint: These accounts stay connected and the hub keeps using them. Nobody can see or disconnect them through the manage link anymore.

manage.title: Your shared accounts
manage.unavailable: This link is not valid. It may have been replaced or deactivated, or all its accounts were disconnected.
manage.intro: {named, select, true {Accounts you connected to the LLM Hub at {instance}.} other {Accounts you connected to this LLM Hub.}}
manage.listTitle: {count, plural, =0 {No connected accounts} one {# connected account} other {# connected accounts}}
manage.listHint: Disconnecting removes the account and its stored sign-in from the hub right away.
manage.state: {state, select, active {Active} expired {Sign-in expired} paused {Paused by the hub} other {{state}}}
manage.removeDescription: The hub deletes this account and its stored sign-in. To connect it again you need a new add-account link.
manage.empty: No account is connected with this link.
manage.vendorHint: You can also end access for the hub at the provider by signing out other sessions or removing connected apps in your account settings.
manage.securityHint: Anyone with this link can see these accounts and disconnect them. Create a new link if others may have seen it, or deactivate it if you no longer need it.
manage.renewDescription: This link stops working right away. The new link is shown only once, so save it before you leave this page.
manage.renewedHint: The old link no longer works. Save this one now, it is shown only once.
manage.revokeDescription: Your accounts stay connected and the hub keeps using them. Nobody can see or disconnect them through this link anymore, including you. To stop sharing later, end the hub's access in your account settings at the provider, or ask an administrator of this hub.
manage.revokedDescription: {count, plural, one {Your account stays connected and the hub keeps using it. This link no longer works, so nobody can see or disconnect it here.} other {Your # accounts stay connected and the hub keeps using them. This link no longer works, so nobody can see or disconnect them here.}}
manage.revokedNext: To stop sharing later, end the hub's access in your account settings at the provider, or ask an administrator of this hub.
